# Walking Memories

## book.awalkaday.art

- [Walking Memories](https://book.awalkaday.art/readme.md): An open-source artist's book tracing the digital footprints of an exiled wanderer and his Belgian pixels during an eight-year odyssey
- [One Step Forward](https://book.awalkaday.art/one-step-forward.md)
- [ARTIST STATEMENT](https://book.awalkaday.art/artist-statement.md): Disclosures and essential information written in the first person.
- [READING GUIDE](https://book.awalkaday.art/reading-guide.md): A list of 15 chapters and 17 subchapters showing on which numbered page each one appears
- [Introduction to the Photo Series](https://book.awalkaday.art/introduction-to-the-photo-series.md)
- [Beyond Pixels: A Stroll Into Nature](https://book.awalkaday.art/beyond-pixels-a-stroll-into-nature.md)
- [Mobile Studio and Digital Toolkit](https://book.awalkaday.art/mobile-studio-and-digital-toolkit.md): The wanderer's burden lightened by rudimentary equipment: Nokia as Air Force One, laptop as command center, and libre software as darkroom
- [On-the-go Photography](https://book.awalkaday.art/mobile-studio-and-digital-toolkit/on-the-go-photography.md)
- [Cameras and Photo Editing](https://book.awalkaday.art/mobile-studio-and-digital-toolkit/cameras-and-photo-editing.md)
- [Gaming Laptop](https://book.awalkaday.art/mobile-studio-and-digital-toolkit/gaming-laptop.md)
- [Chronicle of Milestones Navigation](https://book.awalkaday.art/chronicle-of-milestones-navigation.md): A timeline lining up bits and pieces of the scaffolding and the milestones marking progressive moves of data flows on a cyber terrain
- [Parallel Pathways](https://book.awalkaday.art/chronicle-of-milestones-navigation/parallel-pathways.md)
- [Internet Footprints](https://book.awalkaday.art/chronicle-of-milestones-navigation/internet-footprints.md)
- [Blockchain Records](https://book.awalkaday.art/chronicle-of-milestones-navigation/blockchain-records.md)
- [Evolution of a Trek on Platforms](https://book.awalkaday.art/evolution-of-a-trek-on-platforms.md): Five territories map out nomadism from one computing platform to another in search of visibility, transparency, presentation, discourse, or permanence
- [Instagram](https://book.awalkaday.art/evolution-of-a-trek-on-platforms/instagram.md): Since July 2017
- [GitHub](https://book.awalkaday.art/evolution-of-a-trek-on-platforms/github.md): Since November 2017
- [Web Gallery](https://book.awalkaday.art/evolution-of-a-trek-on-platforms/web-gallery.md): Since May 2021
- [X (Twitter)](https://book.awalkaday.art/evolution-of-a-trek-on-platforms/x-twitter.md): Since November 2021
- [Ethereum](https://book.awalkaday.art/evolution-of-a-trek-on-platforms/ethereum.md): Since August 2022
- [Artist's Proofs and Ethos](https://book.awalkaday.art/artists-proofs-and-ethos.md): Reframing version control philosophy as artistic methodology through transparent iteration, public refinement, and trails of GIT commits
- [Public GIT Commits](https://book.awalkaday.art/artists-proofs-and-ethos/public-git-commits.md)
- [GIT Usage History](https://book.awalkaday.art/artists-proofs-and-ethos/git-usage-history.md)
- [Open Source Software](https://book.awalkaday.art/artists-proofs-and-ethos/open-source-software.md)
- [Artist Profiling](https://book.awalkaday.art/artist-profiling.md): A portrait of a Burundian assembled from fragments of darkened memories: Beijing to Brussels, war filming to refuge seeking, engineer-in-training to undocumented
- [Human Identity](https://book.awalkaday.art/artist-profiling/human-identity.md)
- [Training Ground](https://book.awalkaday.art/artist-profiling/training-ground.md)
- [Project Inception](https://book.awalkaday.art/artist-profiling/project-inception.md)
- [Contact](https://book.awalkaday.art/contact.md)
- [IMPRINT](https://book.awalkaday.art/imprint.md)
- [CATALOGUE](https://book.awalkaday.art/catalogue.md): Lists accounting for the number of all tokenized photographs, split into three categories, and arranged by location, year and season
- [APPENDIX](https://book.awalkaday.art/appendix.md): Three extra spatial stories about the impact of the Belgian-made pixels on Earth and Ethereum
- [POSTSCRIPT](https://book.awalkaday.art/postscript.md): An exhaustive table listing the 263 digital photographs with names, public timestamps and WALK token identifiers

This documentation is published with GitBook. GitBook is the documentation platform designed so that both humans and AI agents can read, navigate, and reason over technical content effectively. Learn more at gitbook.com.

## Querying This Documentation
If you need additional information, you can query the documentation dynamically by asking a question.
Perform an HTTP GET request on a page URL with the `ask` query parameter:
```
GET https://book.awalkaday.art/readme.md?ask=<question>
```
The question should be specific, self-contained, and written in natural language.
The response will contain a direct answer to the question and relevant excerpts and sources from the documentation.
Use this mechanism when the answer is not explicitly present in the current page, you need clarification or additional context, or you want to retrieve related documentation sections.
